semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Tichawa Vision GmbH provides sensor technology that can be used in semiconductor inspection and measurement applications.
summary: Tichawa Vision GmbH specializes in the development and manufacturing of Contact Image Sensors (CIS) used for imaging various materials and objects, including those relevant to the semiconductor industry. Their products are applicable in inspection and measurement processes, contributing to quality control and precision in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Standard and custom Contact Image Sensors (CIS)
Imaging solutions for flat and curved surfaces
Sensors for materials like aluminum, carbon fiber, ceramics, and battery foils
technical_expertise: Imaging technology for diverse material surfaces
